PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'DISK_FREE=$(df -h / | tail -1 | awk "{print \$4}" | sed "s/Gi//"); if [ "${DISK_FREE%%.*}" -lt 10 ]; then echo "BLOCK: Only ${DISK_FREE}GB free — clean build artifacts before committing"; exit 1; fi'
PreToolUse.description: Block commits when disk is critically low

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_file_path"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -q "patrol_test/\|test/"; then echo "Test file modified: $FILE — remember to verify with patrol test or flutter test before committing"; fi'
PostToolUse.description: Remind to test after editing test files
